mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we have clear skies at Verona Community Park and a third quarter moon phase. The overnight low will drop to 45 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

Mayor Diaz has officially declared October as Community Planning Month to honor the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our city's future and development choices. Additionally, residents are reminded to look out for letters regarding mandatory cross-connection control surveys to keep our water supply safe.

Today is packed with activities including the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, followed by trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee this coming Monday.
In a recent report, on September 21, police were called to a retail business on East Verona Avenue where a subject was identified and cited for the retail theft of candy.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so stop by soon to enjoy this flavor while you can.
